proposals.rule: Most people need to pay the immigration health surcharge (IHS) as part of their online immigration application.
proposals.exception: If your course of study is 6 months or less, you do not need to pay the IHS.
proposals.why: students with courses of 6 months or less

proposals.rule: Most people need to pay the immigration health surcharge (IHS) as part of their online immigration application.
proposals.exception: Some people are exempt from paying the surcharge, including people who: are seeking asylum or applying for humanitarian protection (or their dependants) are identified as a victim of human trafficking (or their dependants) are applying for indefinite leave to remain
proposals.why: people seeking asylum, victims of trafficking, or applying for ILR

proposals.rule: Most people need to pay the immigration health surcharge (IHS) as part of their online immigration application.
proposals.exception: You do not need to pay the immigration health surcharge or biometric enrolment fee.
proposals.why: children joining a parent who is their sponsor
